channel.title: Relay Updates
channel.description: Signed updates for Relay on macOS.

item.description:
## Direct screenshot actions with icons
**Copy & Discard** is now its own button beside **Copy & Close**. One click copies the annotated screenshot and closes without saving to Desktop. The dropdown has been removed.
Copy, Copy & Close, Copy & Discard and Save all have icons and labels, with room to fit in the smallest window. Default 100% image sizing and zoom are retained.

## Copy a screenshot without saving to Desktop
Open the small dropdown beside **Copy & Close** and choose **Copy & Discard** to copy the annotated screenshot and close the editor without creating a Desktop file.
**Copy & Close** still copies and saves to Desktop. **Discard** still closes without copying or saving. Screenshot sizing and zoom remain included.

## Screenshot windows that fit the image
- Screenshots now open at 100% actual pixels by default. - The editor grows or shrinks to match the image as you change zoom. - Large images use the available screen space with scrolling; smaller images get a smaller window. - Fit shows the whole screenshot without enlarging small captures. - Markup, Copy & Close, Discard and full-resolution exports are retained.
